title: xDrip+ hard crash with  libre oop algo on new sensor
symptom: xDrip+ crashes consistently when using Libre as collector and out of process algorithm on a brand new sensor, when only one historic bg is available. The crash occurs because the extrapolation library requires at least 3 values.
cause: The extrapolation library (SplineInterpolator) requires at least 3 data points, but when a new sensor has only one historic bg, the code attempts to interpolate with fewer than 3 points, causing a NumberIsTooSmallException.
fix: A fix was submitted in pull request #431, which presumably handles the case with insufficient data points.
evidence_quote: The issue is the fact that the extrapolation library wants to have at least 3 values each time.
